description: This file contains unit tests for the KafkaAuthenticationSpecificConfig class, verifying its applicability, validation, and configuration application logic for Kafka connection credentials, especially focusing on SASL mechanism support and credential presence.

classes.name: KafkaAuthenticationSpecificConfigTest
classes.description: A test class verifying the behavior of KafkaAuthenticationSpecificConfig, especially focusing on SASL mechanisms and credential validity.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes static test fixture data before any tests run.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment before each test.

methods.name: shouldBeApplicableIfCredentialsExist
methods.description: Tests that the config is applicable when credentials are provided.

methods.name: shouldNotBeApplicableIfCredentialsAreMissing
methods.description: Tests that the config is not applicable when credentials are missing.

methods.name: shouldBeValidIfContainsNoSaslMechanism
methods.description: Tests that a connection with no SASL mechanism is considered valid.

methods.name: shouldBeValidIfContainsSupportedSaslMechanism
methods.description: Checks validity when supported SASL mechanisms are used.

methods.name: shouldBeInvalidIfContainsUnsupportedSaslMechanism
methods.description: Verifies that unsupported SASL mechanisms are invalid.

methods.name: shouldValidateIfContainsNoSaslMechanism
methods.description: Ensures validation passes when no SASL mechanism is specified.

methods.name: shouldValidateIfContainsSupportedSaslMechanism
methods.description: Ensures validation passes for supported mechanisms.

methods.name: shouldThrowOnValidationIfContainsUnsupportedSaslMechanism
methods.description: Checks that validation throws exception for unsupported mechanisms.

methods.name: shouldNotValidate
methods.description: Helper method to assert validation failure.

methods.name: shouldNotContainSaslMechanism
methods.description: Helper to check that SASL mechanism is not set in properties.

methods.name: shouldContainPlainSaslMechanism
methods.description: Helper to verify that the correct Plain SASL mechanism configuration is applied.

methods.name: shouldContainScramSaslMechanism
methods.description: Helper to verify SCRAM SASL mechanism configuration.

methods.name: getConnectionWithSaslMechanism
methods.description: Creates a connection object with specified SASL mechanism for testing.

methods.name: getConnectionWithoutUsernameAndPassword
methods.description: Creates a connection object missing credentials.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Constructs a connection object with given credentials and config.

methods.name: getUriWithUserAndPassword
methods.description: Builds a URI string embedding username and password.

methods.name: specificConfigWithSaslMechanism
methods.description: Provides config map with specified SASL mechanism for testing.
